name: Community Services Card
description: The Community Services Card is a card-based assistance product that provides holders with subsidised access to primary health organisation services, public transport (Community Connect), and other health services.

attributes.summary: A card issued to eligible New Zealanders providing subsidised health and other services, subject to residence and income tests.
attributes.eligibility: Eligibility is determined by residence and income tests, with specific rules for different family and relationship configurations, dependent children, and special client categories. Excluded clients include students, overseas students, self-employed clients, and residents of rest homes and hospitals.
attributes.benefits: Subsidised access to Primary Health Organisations, public transport (Community Connect), other health services, and other subsidy cards.
